title: (No AI) Trump orders US government to call AI ‘Super Intelligence’
author: Lauren Feiner
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/gettyimages-2250207971.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Image: Carolyn Van Houten/The Washington Post via Getty Images

The US executive branch is no longer acknowledging the existence of "artificial intelligence." Going forward, official policy websites, policy documents, and press releases will refer only to "Super Intelligence," thanks to a [new executive order](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/09/inaugurating-the-era-of-super-intelligence/) signed by President Donald Trump.

"The word super is the best word of all, and it's the simplest," Trump said at an event announcing the launch of [America.gov](http://america.gov) earlier on Tuesday, and said Chinese President Xi Jinping, who visited the White House last week, "loves it," too. "We don't want to hear artificial. Because it's not artificial. It's very powerful, it's very brilliant. It's going to mostly be …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/policy/1002468/trump-ai-superintelligence-executive-order-ai)

title: (No AI) Elon Musk’s AI-powered Grokipedia is updating again
author: Jay Peters
content:
![Illustration of Elon Musk standing with a blue and orange striped background.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/04/STK171_VRG_Illo_16_Normand_ElonMusk_16.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Elon Musk | Image: Laura Normand / The Verge

Grokipedia, the AI-powered online encyclopedia from SpaceXAI, appears to be updating articles once again after [a months-long pause](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/976004/elon-musk-grokipedia-ai-wikipedia-not-updating-dead). In August, _Lawfare_ [reported that](https://www.lawfaremedia.org/article/grokipedia-stopped-reviewing-edits-in-april.-it-didn-t-tell-anyone) articles on Grokipedia hadn't reviewed edits since April, but the [platform's live updates site](https://grokipedia.com/live) is now showing various recent changes to pages - though as I write this, many are just a note that says "recheck all references and sources."

The site seems to have become active again relatively recently. The page for [President Barack Obama](https://grokipedia.com/page/Barack_Obama) has a note that says it was "Fact-checked by Grok" two days ago, and the page for [Elon Musk](https://grokipedia.com/page/Elon_Musk) was fact-checked while I was writing this, within the …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1002448/elon-musk-grokipedia-ai-updating-again)
